nodes.name: Receive Input
nodes.notes: Formal input contract for this sub-workflow: workflow_run_id + storyboard_json (the object produced by 'Arya OS - Storyboard', containing storyboard_id + a shots array). Can also be run manually for standalone testing with pinned sample data.

nodes.name: Loop Over Storyboard Scenes
nodes.notes: Splits storyboard_json.shots into one item per shot. Each resulting item carries the shot under 'shot' plus workflow_run_id/storyboard_json still attached (include: allOtherFields), so every downstream node in this chain automatically runs once per shot — n8n's normal per-item execution model IS the loop here. If per-shot rate-limiting is ever needed (e.g. to avoid overloading a self-hosted ComfyUI/RunPod GPU box), swap this for a 'Loop Over Items' (Split In Batches) node with batchSize=1 instead.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Image Generator API (Future ComfyUI)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_run_id: $json.workflow_run_id, storyboard_id: $json.storyboard_json.storyboard_id, shot_number: $json.shot.shot, prompt: $json.shot.description ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_SHOT_DESCRIPTION', shot_type: $json.shot.shot_type ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_SHOT_TYPE' }) }}

nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER endpoint — no real ComfyUI/RunPod instance is wired in yet (backend/app/providers/capabilities.py already reserves 'comfyui' as a self-hosted image/video provider for this exact purpose, but no HTTP client for it exists yet). Runs once per shot automatically. continueOnFail is enabled so one failed shot doesn't abort image generation for every other shot in the storyboard — failures are still visible per-item in the final images_json output. TODO: no backend route brokers this call either — the backend's own provider-routing/fallback/cost-ceiling logic (backend/app/providers/router.py) is currently bypassed entirely by calling a provider host directly from n8n. Not fixed here (would be a redesign) — flagged for a future decision: either point this at a backend route that wraps ProviderRouter, or accept that n8n owns provider selection for this stage. retryOnFail added (3 tries, 2s apart) for transient network errors against the eventual real provider.

nodes.name: Set - Build Shot Image Result

assignments.name: shot_result
assignments.value: ={{ { shot_number: $('Loop Over Storyboard Scenes').item.json.shot.shot ?? null, storage_path: $json.storage_path ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE_STORAGE_PATH', provider_name: $json.provider_name ?? 'comfyui', prompt_id: $json.prompt_id ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_PROMPT_ID', error: $json.error ?? null } }}

nodes.notes: Normalizes each per-shot HTTP response into a stable shape (shot_number, storage_path, provider_name, prompt_id, error) before aggregation — matches backend/app/models/media.py's Image table fields.

nodes.name: Aggregate - Collect Image Paths
nodes.notes: Combines all per-shot 'shot_result' items (one per shot, from the loop above) back into a single 'images' array in one item — this is the point where the per-shot loop ends and a single images_json object can be built.

nodes.name: Return images_json

assignments.name: images_json
assignments.value: ={{ { workflow_run_id: $('Receive Input').item.json.workflow_run_id, storyboard_id: $('Receive Input').item.json.storyboard_json.storyboard_id ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_STORYBOARD_ID', images: $json.images.map(i => i.shot_result), image_count: $json.images.length } }}

nodes.notes: Final output contract for this sub-workflow: a single top-level 'images_json' object ({ storyboard_id, images[], image_count }), consumed by the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node. Reads storyboard_id back from the original 'Receive Input' node so it survives the aggregation step above regardless of loop content. FIXED: now also preserves workflow_run_id (was missing from output).

main.node: HTTP Request - Image Generator API (Future ComfyUI)

meta.notes: Sprint 1-3 scaffold sub-workflow. Input contract: workflow_run_id + storyboard_json. Loops over storyboard_json.shots (one HTTP call per shot, via n8n's normal per-item execution rather than a manual SplitInBatches loop, since no rate-limiting is needed yet). The HTTP Request node points at a placeholder ComfyUI-style endpoint — no real self-hosted image provider is wired in yet (ImageAgent in backend/app/agents/image.py is still a NotImplementedError stub). Output contract: a single top-level 'images_json' object, intended to be called via Execute Workflow from 'Arya OS - Main Orchestrator'.
